name: Notion
description: Your Notion pages and databases found by title, and a page read right in Quick Open, with an integration of yours.

preferences.title: Integration Secret
preferences.description: An internal integration's secret: make one at app.notion.com/developers/connections › Internal connections › Create a new connection (a workspace owner can), with Read content; its API token is on its Configuration tab. It sees only pages shared with it: in a page's ••• menu, Connections, add it (its subpages come too). A personal access token, made there too, works as well, and sees what you can. It's used only to ask api.notion.com.
